description: This Java class 'JmsServiceEngine' extends 'AbstractEngine' and manages JMS messaging for services, including sending messages to topics and queues, handling JNDI lookups, and integrating with transaction management.

classes.name: JmsServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that manages JMS messaging for services, including sending messages to topics and queues, handling JNDI lookups, and integrating with transaction management.

methods.name: getServiceElement
methods.description: Retrieves the JmsService configuration element based on the model service.

methods.name: makeMessage
methods.description: Creates a JMS MapMessage with serialized service context.

methods.name: serverList
methods.description: Returns list of server elements based on send mode.

methods.name: runTopic
methods.description: Publishes a message to a JMS topic.

methods.name: runQueue
methods.description: Sends a message to a JMS queue.

methods.name: runXaQueue
methods.description: Sends a message to an XA queue with transaction enlistment.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes messaging to configured servers based on service configuration.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs messaging process ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs messaging asynchronously without a requester.
